title: Story of Eve - A Hero's Study

Eve Rukia, newbie adventurer, has a crush on the Hero. She started her adventure to get stronger and catch his attention but things aren‘t going well. Will she be able to become a hero or...Contents• 6 Outfits - "The less it covers, the more powerful it is!"

• 6 Violation Scenes - Eve's adventures don't always end well.

• 3 Special Events - Heart-pounding events between her adventures.

• 1 Nude Outfit - Technically, it's also an outfit.

• A simple rock-paper-scissors card battle RPG

• Costume Collection & Defeat Violation
